\begin{tablenotes}\notesize
\item Notes: The 1,000 tasks are a stratified sample of the 19,281, with every major occupation group represented. Every model rated the same fixed subtasks with ratings A, B, and C at all four stages through OpenRouter, with temperature 0, seed 12345, and JSON output. Agreement is the Spearman correlation across tasks between the model's stage-4 composite score and Claude Haiku 4.5's original score; retest is the Spearman correlation between two runs of rating A, stage 4. Cost covers ratings A, B, and C on the 1,000 tasks. The two Kimi models were stopped because their long reasoning output made them slow (about 400 requests an hour); Gemini 3.5 Flash was dropped before the pilot on its projected cost. Within each developer the cheaper model agreed with Claude at least as well as the dearer one. The last row re-ran the original Claude pipeline on the same 1,000 tasks through the Anthropic batch API; its agreement column is the correlation between the two Claude runs.
